errors.meaning: additional_authorities is not a list of at most 8 acc:// key book URLs, or its two spellings (top level and intent.additionalAuthorities) disagree. The message names the entry.
additional_authorities names the principal ADI's own key book, which already authorizes the intent through its account.
errors.action: Remove it. List only OTHER parties whose signature this transaction also needs.

errors.meaning: A downstream service failed. The request may or may not have taken effect.
errors.action: Retry with the SAME Idempotency-Key where the operation accepts one.

errors.meaning: The request was understood but is not valid for this operation.
Billing is switched off on this deployment; billing endpoints are unavailable.

The chain is in the CERTEN network catalogue but this gateway has not enabled it, so it is neither served, quoted nor linkable. Distinct from UNKNOWN_CHAIN (the name is real) and from CHAIN_NOT_PRICEABLE (no measurement will make it available; enabling it is an operator decision).
errors.action: Use a chain listed by GET /v1/chains.

errors.meaning: This chain has too little measured cost data to be priced safely. CERTEN refuses to guess rather than charge a number it cannot stand behind.
Work on this chain is suspended.
The chain identifier could not be resolved to a deployment.
errors.action: List valid chains with GET /v1/chains.

errors.meaning: The balance covers this request but not everything already promised. Pending multi-signature intents charge when quorum is reached, which can be weeks later.
errors.action: See GET /v1/billing/obligations for which intents claimed it.

errors.meaning: The resource already exists, or its state has moved on since you read it.
The measured cost history of the chain holds costs recorded in an asset other than its native asset in the network catalogue, so no quote is derived from it.
The database ended the connection this request was using (for example an idle-in-transaction timeout or a failover). Nothing the request wrote was committed.
errors.action: Retry with the SAME Idempotency-Key where the operation accepts one.

errors.meaning: No entitlement epoch has been published yet. Validators enforcing the gate refuse every intent.
expires_at is not an RFC 3339 date-time with a timezone, or its two spellings disagree.
expires_at is in the past, too soon, or too far ahead. The message states the accepted window (INTENT_EXPIRY_MIN_S to INTENT_EXPIRY_MAX_S seconds from now).
The credential is valid but lacks the scope this operation requires.
errors.action: Check GET /v1/me for granted scopes and GET /v1/scopes for what each covers. Scopes are fixed at key creation — a key missing one has to be reissued.

errors.meaning: A manual FX observation was submitted for an asset rated only from two agreeing independent sources (ETH and TEL). Only the FX feed records its rate, from both sources.

The chain pays gas in an asset rated only from two independent sources (CoinGecko and CoinPaprika; ETH and TEL), and no fresh rate on which both agreed within the configured tolerance exists: a source is failing or stale, or they disagree. No single-source or fallback rate is used, so nothing on the chain is quoted or priced until they agree again.
errors.action: Retry later; operators see the reason in certen_gateway_fx_feed_failures_total (status label SYMBOL:reason) and the FX feed log.

errors.meaning: No signed FX observation is available, so a gas-priced charge cannot be converted to USD.

This deployment refuses additional_authorities on intents: CERTEN validators do not yet count signatures from transaction-header authorities (gap G-18), so such an intent would be delivered on Accumulate and then never execute.
errors.action: Make the party an account-level authority instead: add its key book to the principal's <adi>/data account with POST /v1/governance add_authority, and omit additional_authorities.

errors.meaning: An identical request with this Idempotency-Key is still running.
errors.action: Wait and retry the SAME key. Using a new key would perform the work twice.

errors.meaning: This Idempotency-Key was already used with a DIFFERENT request body.
errors.action: A key binds to one request. Use a new key, or resend the original body.

errors.meaning: The ledger refused the charge for lack of funds.
errors.action: Add funds. Gate on `remaining_usd` from GET /v1/billing/balance, not `spendable_usd`.

errors.meaning: The intent passed its expires_at before it was signed, so it can no longer complete. It is now failed with reason_code expired and nothing was charged.
errors.action: Create a new intent, with a later expires_at if the signers need more time.

errors.meaning: An unhandled fault. The request id in the response identifies it in our logs.
A balance was modified without holding the account lock.
A customer-account leg carried no organization.
A hold would have gone negative.
A ledger entry group did not sum to zero and was refused. Double-entry invariant.
A platform-account leg carried an organization.
A ledger leg of zero was refused.
The transparency log diverged from its expected head, or a proof built from its stored tree nodes did not verify against the published root. No proof is served rather than one that would not verify.
A stored transparency-log tree node needed for this proof is missing. No proof is served rather than one that could not be built.
A cost event reported a native asset or base unit other than the one the network catalogue gives the chain, so it was not priced. The reporting validator parks it with its gas facts intact.
The network catalogue gives the chain no native asset (networks.json "nativeAsset"), so its gas cannot be priced. CERTEN prices a chain only in its own native asset and never in a guessed one.
errors.action: Add the native asset of the chain to certen-contracts networks.json and regenerate the gateway catalogue.

errors.meaning: No price book is in effect, so nothing can be priced.
No such resource for this organization. Ids are org-scoped, so another org's id reads as missing.
The balance does not cover this work. NOTHING WAS CHARGED AND NO WORK WAS STARTED.
errors.action: The body carries a binding quote and a live payment target — send exactly `resolve.amount_usd`, then retry with `quote_id` before `quote_expires_at`.

errors.meaning: A plan limit is exhausted — not a per-second rate, a quota for the period.
errors.action: Waiting will not clear this within the period. Raise the plan limit.

errors.meaning: A proof request reached the proof-service client without the organisation it is for, so no tenant key could be derived. The request was not sent.
errors.action: This is a gateway defect: report it to the platform operators with the intent id.

errors.meaning: The gateway has no PROOFS_TENANT_KEY_SECRET (or one shorter than 32 bytes), so it cannot derive the API key the proof service requires for a tenant. The proof request was not sent.
errors.action: Platform operators: set PROOFS_TENANT_KEY_SECRET on the gateway and its worker. Callers cannot fix this.

errors.meaning: The quote passed its expiry before the work was submitted.
errors.action: Request a new quote. They are free.

errors.meaning: The quote does not match the work being submitted — a different chain, sku or leg count.
Too many requests in the current window.
errors.action: Wait `retry_after_seconds`, which is also the Retry-After header. Retrying sooner cannot succeed and still counts against the limit.

errors.meaning: A receipt total did not match its own computation inputs and was refused.
The active signing key is not in the published verification key set.
The receipt signing key could not be loaded, so a receipt cannot be signed.
A database constraint rejected the write.
A downstream service token is not configured on this deployment.
The share link was real and is now revoked, expired, or out of views.
errors.action: Ask the sender for a fresh link. This is NOT "the proof does not exist".

errors.meaning: Polling faster than the endpoint allows, on the device-authorization flow.
errors.action: Increase the poll interval to the value the flow published.

errors.meaning: The timestamping service could not be reached.
Generic throttle. See Retry-After.
No credential, or one the gateway does not recognise.
errors.action: Send X-API-Key, or a portal session as Authorization: Bearer.

errors.meaning: No chain by that name is served. Distinct from CHAIN_NOT_PRICEABLE, which is a real chain that cannot be priced yet: that one is worth retrying and this one never will be. The message names the closest match when there is one.
A field failed schema validation. The message names the field and what it expected.
errors.action: Fix the named field. `details` carries the per-field entries for programmatic use.
